typography.usage_rules: Use Outfit for all main headings (h1, h2). Use Inter for all data tables, inputs, and long-form text. Use Uppercase Label style for table headers and form labels.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-all

cards.base: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden
cards.meal_slot: bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-primary/5 transition-all cursor-pointer rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[120px] p-4 group
cards.meal_filled: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all rounded-xl p-4 relative overflow-hidden group

inputs.base: flex h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

dialogs.content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-lg translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 sm:rounded-2xl

glassmorphism.header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/40 sticky top-0 z-40

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise or grain on the main background if possible to give it a 'paper' feel.

rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text.
Interactive elements must have focus states (ring-2 ring-primary).
Use semantic HTML (section, article, header, main).
All images must have alt text.
Do not rely on color alone for status (use icons + text).

assets.icons: Use Lucide React icons. Stroke width: 1.5px or 2px. Rounded caps.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION LANGUAGE: SPANISH. All UI text, labels, and placeholders must be in Spanish.
THEME: Strict Light Mode. Use the specified warm white/beige background.
LAYOUT: The main dashboard is the 'Weekly Planner'. Use a 7-column grid (one for each day) on desktop, single column on mobile.
INTERACTION: Clicking an empty meal slot opens a Shadcn Dialog to add a meal.
SHOPPING LIST: This should be a separate view or a side-drawer. It aggregates ingredients from the week.
VISUALS: Avoid standard 'table' borders. Use cards for days. Use plenty of whitespace.
DATA: No nutritional info needed. Just 'Meal Name' and 'Ingredients' (list).
TYPOGRAPHY: Import fonts via Google Fonts (Outfit and Inter) in index.css.
ICONS: Use Lucide icons for meal types (Sun for Breakfast, Utensils for Lunch, Moon for Dinner).
universal_guidelines: Do not center align the app container.
Create components in /components/ui using Shadcn patterns but customized styles.
Use data-testid for all interactive elements.
